Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) High-level recap from our call
- You confirmed MediBridge will onboard the new scheduling + chart-summary feature that will process limited PHI extracted from inbound EHR messages (patient name, DOB, limited notes).
- Primary security asks: BAA availability, where PHI can be processed/stored, and checklist for vendor security questionnaire (you shared an intake template during the call).

2) What Redwood can offer (summary attachments included)
- SOC 2: We maintain a Type II report (summary attached). Full report available under NDA — we can route that to your procurement/security team.
- BAA: Redwood offers a BAA for customers handling PHI. We recommend Private or Dedicated deployments for production PHI workloads; Hosted API with BAA is limited to scoped, lower-risk PHI patterns and requires special intake review.
- Deployment modes: see attached "redwood-deployment-options.pdf" for benefits/constraints of Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Short version: Private (VPC/on-prem) = strictest, Dedicated = isolated GPU pools, Hosted = fastest but with restrictions for PHI.

3) Immediate asks / next steps
- Jordan: Please attach your vendor security questionnaire (we can start intake and assign an owner).
- Aditya (cc'd): Can you confirm the PHI boundary guidance (what we can accept in Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and any evidence artifacts we should prepare?
- Marissa: I'll loop in legal/procurement once Jordan confirms the questionnaire so we can pull the SOC 2 full report under NDA and begin a draft BAA.

Proposed timeline: intake questionnaire returned by 05/28 -> Redwood response with completed questionnaire & SOC2 artifacts by 06/03 -> contract/BAA draft week of 06/07 (if scope unchanged).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-deployment-options.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up if helpful.

Subject: Re: Follow-up: PHI handling boundaries, BAA availability & questionnaire kickoff

Jordan — thanks for the fast turn. Quick technical clarifications below (short answers first, then notes).

Short answers:
- Encryption: Yes — TLS 1.2+/mTLS available in Hosted and Dedicated; at-rest encryption supported for all deployments (customer-managed keys available in Dedicated/Private).
- Retention: Default logs/observability retention is 90 days for Hosted; Dedicated/Private can be configured to shorter retention windows and to disable token-level logging. For PHI we recommend disabling token logs and enabling strict KV/prefix caching controls.
- Storage of KV cache / model state: For Hosted, ephemeral cache lives on shared nodes and is not suitable for regulated PHI at scale; Dedicated stores KV cache in isolated pools; Private gives you full control (on-prem or VPC with customer-managed storage).

More detail / how we usually scope: 
- Hosted (with BAA): We can accept narrowly-scoped PHI patterns for pilot/test with contractual constraints — limited throughput, ingest filtering, and strict logging controls. For production PHI, our compliance path recommends Dedicated or Private because they provide stronger isolation and KMS integration options (HSM/KMS BYOK).
- BAA process: Redwood provides a standard BAA; our legal team will tailor the attachment to the deployment mode. We typically require a security intake to confirm flows and retention before signing.

Concrete next steps from a tech intake perspective:
1) We'll run through the MB_vendor_qs.xlsx and flag any items needing artifacts. I'll take ownership of Q1–Q12 in the questionnaire and aim to return completed answers + SOC 2 artifact links by 06/03.
2) If you share a short data-flow diagram (even a hand sketch) showing where PHI originates and downstream recipients, that will help us map to an eligible deployment and required controls.

I'll also note a known constraint: Hosted can be configured to disable token-level retention, but some telemetry at the request-metadata level (latency/trace ids) is retained for troubleshooting; we can redact request/response bodies for PHI workloads if needed.

Happy to sync on a quick technical session with your infra/security folks later this week — propose Thu 05/27 10:00 PDT if that works.

—Aditya
